title: pavonia guianensis
intro: Pavonia guianensis, commonly known as the "Guianese rosemallow," is a plant species in the mallow family (Malvaceae) native to the Guiana Shield region of South America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The health benefits of Pavonia guianensis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
